summary: Compact box showing an event date: prominent day, uppercase abbreviated month, and optionally the weekday. Formatted with Intl according to the locale and rendered as <time dateTime>.
whenToUse: Covers and rows for events, meetups, webinars, deadlines.
Compact lists where the date is the first thing users scan.
whenNotToUse: Dates with times or complex ranges in text: use Intl.DateTimeFormat in a regular <time>.
Selecting a date: use DatePicker or Calendar.

props.name: date
props.description: Day to display: Date, ISO string (“2026-11-12”), or a CalendarDate-like object (1-based month).

props.name: variant
props.description: solid: light box to place on colored covers; gradient: box with the brand gradient.

props.name: showWeekday
props.description: Shows the abbreviated weekday above the number.

props.name: timeZone
props.description: IANA time zone used to read the day from a Date object (default: the user's).

inherits: HTML attributes of <time> (id, style, data-*, aria-*); ref to the <time> element.
accessibility: Rendered as <time dateTime="YYYY-MM-DD">, readable by search engines and assistive technologies.
The abbreviated visual parts are aria-hidden: screen readers read the full localized date (e.g. “Thursday, November 12, 2026”).
In forced-colors mode the box uses Canvas/CanvasText with a visible border.
responsive: Intrinsic size: it does not stretch; use size="sm" in dense lists or sidebars.
commonMistakes: Passing a string with a UTC time (“2026-11-12T23:30:00Z”) and expecting the UTC day: dates with times follow the user's time zone or timeZone.
Repeating the same date as text next to the badge: it is already announced in full.

examples.name: Variants
examples.title: Variants
examples.description: solid on a colored cover and gradient on a neutral surface.

limits: Shows a single day: for multi-day ranges place two badges side by side or use text.
